source_revision_boundary.measured_candidate: uncommitted stage1 candidate identified by binary SHA-256; stage2 changes are not covered

measurement_contract.topology: Windows one host, four original native node processes and independent fixture databases; not four physical machines
measurement_contract.payment_contract: Concrete asset accounts, ML-DSA-65, original NovoRUDP/APFL ingress, CPU callbacks business execution
measurement_contract.primary_timing: First SDK submission attempt through all unique transaction receipt observations on ALL FOUR nodes; startup, initial signing/APFL preparation, final economics audit and cold recovery are excluded. Later continuous-mode signing/preparation remains inside the one uninterrupted clock.
measurement_contract.latency: Each row's first wire-frame submission attempt to slowest of four receipt-query observations. This is client observation latency, not an internal journal timestamp.
measurement_contract.cold_startup_accounting: GPU startup qualification is outside the primary TPS window in the stage1 candidate; startup readiness and startup-through-four-receipts are reported separately. Comparison with baseline lazy qualification is not pure steady-state execution speedup.
measurement_contract.static_same_bytes: Static paired runs replay the identical signed corpus and initial state within each group. Different groups have different random fixtures/domains and cannot be spliced into an exact before/after.
measurement_contract.continuous_same_bytes: Continuous runs share approved synthetic genesis and logical workload, but receipt-anchored validity and signatures are not guaranteed identical. First CPU/GPU hashes happened to match; CPU repeat differs. Raw reports preserve exact hashes.
measurement_contract.continuous_generator_metric_caveat: continuous_generator_starved_poll_us counts complete driver poll turns when prepared frames are exhausted while more rows remain, including four-receipt/inflight gating; it is NOT isolated signer wait time. Generation task wall overlaps polling and must not be added or subtracted.
measurement_contract.gpu_contention: All four node processes share one local GPU when gpu_required; not one GPU per independent host
measurement_contract.historical_12k: Not recovered. Historical V3/Ed25519 result used a different account/transaction/signature contract and is a performance objective, not an exact causal comparison.

partial_before_after_4096.interpretation: CPU sample improves slightly; GPU timed transaction phase completes faster but subsequent cold recovery fails, so this incomplete before/after series is NOT a green candidate acceptance or stable performance proof.
